cuda_changes: Adopted fixed dispatch; native strided inputs including input-reuse packing, observer-visible shared activation, and seven-row reuse with unchanged per-shape K-slice arithmetic. Optional caller-owned W4 partial sums and arrival counters isolate early DFlash2 context preparation; arithmetic and default scratch ownership remain unchanged. Optional direct rank-packet MHC consumer preserves canonical FP32 sum and BF16 input rounding. Optional direct TX-slot output resolves its address after the producer dependency and system-fences every final writer; W4/input-reuse arithmetic is unchanged. Qualified wide-row input reuse packs each activation once without changing the ordinary MMA/reduction; the packed-input specialization remains separate from direct TX-slot production. K=7 C1 output and paired-query projections keep their original K slices inside one CTA, eliminating global partial/counter traffic; K=1536/2048/3072 specializations retain the original accumulation and rounding order. Bound C1 forward projections parallelize independent K-block MMA products while preserving the original per-slice FMA and final fold order. Joined C1 query grids retain the proven asynchronous W4 reader and separate output ranges. Rejected direct-register readers were removed. A C1 packed MHC prototype assigns eight tails to fixed CTAs of the two-token group, keeping every chunk arrival and arithmetic operation while removing shared tail/exit tickets. Same-build native controls retain the dynamic scheduler; adoption is gated by numerical replay and timing.
